parts.text: Identify rational combination strategies to overcome primary and acquired resistance to KRAS inhibitors in non-small cell lung cancer. Distinguish genomic, cell-state, and tumor-microenvironment mechanisms and propose discriminating validation experiments.

Design a research program to preserve muscle function and lean tissue during GLP-1-based obesity treatment. Distinguish tissue quantity from strength and function and define clinically meaningful endpoints, controls, and go/no-go criteria.

Prioritize drug and nontraditional combination strategies against multidrug-resistant Gram-negative infections. Incorporate rapid diagnostics, resistance evolution, PK/PD, safety, and feasible clinical-trial designs.
